title: CloudTrail PutBucketPolicy event — DET-19-02 Detection Test
event_type: AWS CloudTrail management event, eventSource s3.amazonaws.com, eventName PutBucketPolicy

callouts.explanation: PutBucketPolicy is one of the two calls (with PutBucketAcl) that actually writes a public grant — this is the specific API the DET-19-02 query filters on.
The embedded policy document's bare-string "Principal": "*" with no narrowing Condition is exactly the pattern the query's principal_wildcard/has_narrowing_condition logic is built to catch.
Identifies which bucket was exposed — the field the query surfaces in its output table for triage.
Identifies the throwaway sandbox principal that made the call, matching the Detection Test's setup of a non-allowlisted IAM user.
